name: Hacker's Den
description: A dark room lit only by the glow of seventeen monitors, each showing code that's definitely not supposed to be accessible. Energy drink cans form a small fortress around a gaming chair held together by hope and duct tape. Cables snake across the floor like technological spaghetti. Post-it notes with passwords cover every surface (the password is always 'password123'). A VR headset sits abandoned after someone saw what the hotel management doesn't want you to see. The smell of pizza and desperation lingers.
